scope: Conduct one outcome-blind public-metadata-only feasibility qualification of a controlled-access Swiss pathway that would require lawful research access to NCSC mandatory critical-infrastructure cyberattack records and a documented linkage or denominator construction using FSO STATENT or an equivalent official enterprise frame; persist one aggregate gate result; and stop before application, contact, restricted access, source selection, or outcome inspection.

qualification_contract.pathway_identity: NCSC mandatory critical-infrastructure cyberattack administrative records plus FSO STATENT or an equivalent official enterprise population frame
gates: A public controlled-access route exists for eligible external research institutions.
The authorized research purpose could include independent statistical validation using confidential administrative cybersecurity records.
NCSC records can lawfully be disclosed to or processed for the research route without defeating statutory confidentiality or purpose limitation.
An official enterprise or covered-operator denominator can be accessed or constructed for the same observation periods.
Stable pseudonymous linkage keys or an authorized trusted-linkage service are publicly documented.
Non-reporting covered organization-periods can be represented as explicit zero-event observations without treating unknown compliance as zero.
Incident counts and realized monetary-loss fields, including currency and censoring metadata, are advertised for controlled research use.
Deidentification, disclosure review, secure-environment, output-export, retention, deletion, and onward-disclosure rules are compatible with the frozen OPT-014 design.
Record-level lineage and overlap controls can distinguish NCSC voluntary and mandatory reports and exclude known IRIS, Advisen, VERIS, DBIR, Canadian, and Eurostat overlap.
Access terms, license, institutional eligibility, application steps, expected review authority, advertised fees, and version or vintage controls are publicly documented.
qualification_contract.evidence_rule: Assign documented-pass or documented-fail only from direct official public wording. Missing, implied, or ambiguous metadata remains unresolved; no favorable inference is permitted.
qualification_contract.overall_rule: The pathway is publicly-actionable only if every legal-access, confidentiality, denominator, zero-period, linkage, required-field, privacy, and governance gate is a documented pass. Any documented legal prohibition makes it not-publicly-actionable; otherwise one or more unresolved mandatory gates makes it conditionally feasible but not publicly actionable.

outcome_blinding.permitted_inputs: Only public legal, governance, institutional-eligibility, confidentiality, linkage, schema, access, license, security, retention, disclosure-review, version, format, size, and fee metadata may affect qualification.
outcome_blinding.forbidden_inputs: No incident totals, rates, loss values, distributions, records, organization identities, model performance, or prior agreement may be inspected or used.
outcome_blinding.incidental_value_quarantine: If a permitted page co-mingles outcome values, do not transcribe, persist, compare, summarize, or use them; stop reading that section and record only that quarantine occurred.
outcome_blinding.translation_rule: Use publisher-provided language variants or direct official wording only; no translation provider or uploaded text is authorized.

deterministic_funnel: Verify frozen design, Swiss discovery result, receipt, and production-store digest offline.
Inspect FSO public research-data, data-linkage, confidentiality, institutional-eligibility, contract, and secure-access metadata.
Inspect NCSC public confidentiality, mandatory-reporting, data-use, disclosure, and administrative-record access metadata.
Inspect applicable federal legal and data-protection metadata only as needed to resolve the frozen gates.
Assign each gate exactly one frozen state without contacting an authority or accessing restricted material.
Persist one aggregate feasibility result and stop.

allowed_reads: Official public landing, legal-basis, methodology, privacy, confidentiality, research-access, data-linkage, contract-requirement, institutional-eligibility, secure-environment, disclosure-review, fee, retention, deletion, license, schema, and version metadata on the exact enumerated hosts.
Metadata-only search results restricted to the exact enumerated hosts; an unlisted result or redirect may not be opened or used as evidence.
Document headers and relevant governance sections only; linked records, tables, cubes, APIs, previews, samples, outcomes, application portals, and authenticated systems remain excluded.
forbidden_actions: Credentials, login, account creation, terms or license acceptance, application, inquiry, contact, purchase, payment, restricted-data request, or protected portal access
Raw, row-level, sample, preview, extract, table, cube, API-data response, archive, CSV, JSON, database, spreadsheet, microdata, incident, or organization record access
Outcome, incident-count, loss-value, rate, quantile, distribution, correlation, performance, or prior-agreement inspection or persistence
Dataset code, notebook, query, API client, scanner, simulation, fitting, scoring, model, or translation-provider execution
Source acquisition selection, adequacy threshold, cohort or holdout selection, linkage-key construction, deduplication implementation, evaluation, fitting, prior or methodology change
Production-store access or mutation, schema migration, assessment, label, training, rescoring, OPT-014 lifecycle change, OPT-010 execution, branch integration, remote push, or deployment
stop_conditions: The design, Swiss discovery result, frozen receipt, or production-store digest drifts.
A required page redirects to or loads material from an unlisted host.
Resolving a mandatory gate requires login, terms acceptance, application, contact, restricted material, record access, outcome inspection, or an undocumented favorable inference.
The document, time, byte, or result ceiling would be exceeded.
Any source selection, acquisition, adequacy judgment, evaluation, store, model, policy, lifecycle, branch, remote, or deployment action is attempted.
result_boundary: The result may report only aggregate gate states, official access-path identities, blocking rules, unresolved requirements, and one overall public-actionability classification. It may not disclose records or outcomes, apply for access, select or acquire a source, clear the OPT-014 data gate, judge statistical adequacy, change a prior or methodology, or change OPT-014 status.

authorization.required_statement: I authorize the OPT-014 Swiss controlled-access feasibility qualification described by opt-014-swiss-controlled-access-feasibility-receipt-2026-08-18.json, limited to one outcome-blind public-metadata-only audit of the legal, institutional, confidentiality, research-access, linkage, denominator, zero-period, required-field, deidentification, secure-environment, disclosure-review, retention, deletion, license, fee, and version gates for a pathway combining NCSC mandatory critical-infrastructure cyberattack records with FSO STATENT or an equivalent official enterprise frame; classification of each frozen gate as documented pass, documented fail, or unresolved; quarantine of incidentally visible outcomes; and one aggregate feasibility result, with ceilings of 20 minutes, 5 MiB new data, 24 metadata documents, only bfs.admin.ch, www.bfs.admin.ch, dam-api.bfs.admin.ch, www.swissstats.bfs.admin.ch, ncsc.admin.ch, www.ncsc.admin.ch, admin.ch, www.admin.ch, fedlex.admin.ch, www.fedlex.admin.ch, edoeb.admin.ch, and www.edoeb.admin.ch network access, and exactly zero uploads, provider calls, tokens, cost, dataset downloads, raw record reads, applications, contacts, production-store reads or mutations, assessments, labels, simulation runs, model training, or rescoring. Credentials, login, account creation, terms acceptance, applications, inquiries, contact, purchase, payment, restricted-data requests, protected portals, records, tables, cubes, API data, previews, samples, outcomes, linkage-key construction, source acquisition selection, adequacy thresholds, cohort or holdout selection, evaluation, fitting, prior or methodology changes, production-policy changes, OPT-014 promotion or closure, OPT-010 execution, branch integration, remote push, and deployment remain excluded.
